annotation: Assistant-curated source-level identity labels, inspected before any model predictions; not independently reviewed by a tax professional. Visual inspection of BOE image annexes; text/title/field inspection for recognition pages. Source jurisdiction and form are targets, not claims that every isolated page contains enough evidence.
selection: Purposive sample of official public PDFs found on 2026-09-20. First two distinct content pages where practical; payment pages and annexes add layout diversity. Avoid duplicate taxpayer/administration copies. 100: pages 1,2,49 (payment); 840: 1,3,5; 390: 2,3,4 (forms, skip preceding numerical worksheet); Bizkaia: 4,12,14,22 (first body page, explicit 303 mentions, foral section). Keep selected blank/dynamic and image-only pages as extraction controls. Exclude all four previously evaluated Modelo 303 PDF pages and their source documents. No random or population-representative sampling.
